title: Mall world /lucid dreaming
content: Hi there. This is really bizarre for me that this thread exists. I have had lucid dreams since I could dream. In fact when I was little I remember noticing things about dreams that seemed suspicious and knowing it was going to turn into a bad dream, and making myself wake up. Ive dreamt of all types of things and places and people (dead and alive), and in my dreams there are definitely reoccurring places. Each time I describe lucid dreaming to people I describe these reoccurring places to show them how ive been basically living in these scenarios and places my whole life in some sense. One of them that I always describe is this MALL. I always say "I know this mall, I know where all the stores are, and I can see it in my head right now, it's the same every-time but it's not a mall I've been too, and it grows as I'm there. " It always makes me feel like I'm returning there. Sometimes the entire dream is just me trying to get out of it. Bizarre.
